# Protected paths, vcf-ops-mcp.
#
# Single source of truth for which paths require a signed consensus
# decision record (docs/decisions/NNN-*.md) before a PR touching them can
# merge. Read by tools/consensus-check.py, enforced by
# .github/workflows/consensus.yml. Format: one path per line; a trailing
# '/' matches the directory recursively.

# The design contract.
docs/SPEC.md

# The constitution and its generated twin (AGENTS.md is generated from
# CLAUDE.md by tools/generate_agents_md.sh).
CLAUDE.md
AGENTS.md

# Safety-critical server core once it exists: target registry, credential
# store, action gating/plan-then-apply, audit log. A unilateral change
# here can silently weaken the read-only default or the prod hard-block.
src/vcf_ops_mcp/

# The team framework surface.
roles/
.github/protected-paths.txt
